section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1994
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1994 N.C.R.B. - 36 1.4.4 At the country level, the major contributor of deaths due to 'Road Accidents', 'Railway Accidents', 'Drowning' and 'Fire Accidents' increased by 13.3%, 9.2%, 4.8% and 4.1% respectively during 1994 over previous year. However, at the state-level the position for extreme variations is as under for these causes.
